title: [Origins]: Uravity
description: Wield the forces of gravity and explore the world as Uravity from Boku no Hero Academia.
body:
![Uravity Title Image](https://i.imgur.com/fLYvMuf.png) ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/RyU8vGS2?style=plastic&labelColor=994063&color=E78AAE) ![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/RyU8vGS2?style=plastic&labelColor=%23994063&color=%23E78AAE&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fdatapack%2Furavity%2Fversions)
Using the forces of gravity, this origin allows you to be Uravity from Boku no Hero Academia. Wander your way through the world, reducing the gravity of yourself and those in your way.
#
Powers
**[+]** Zero Gravity - By pressing your fingertips together, you gain the ability to reduce your gravity and float yourself. However, in exchange, you'll get motion sick if you eat and your body is significantly more fragile. Press your primary key to raise the amount of gravity removed or crouch and press the same key to remove a part of the gravity removed. **[+]** Pulsar Boots - Activate the thrusters in your boots, releasing air from the back of your boots that launches you in the direction you look. **[+]** Nebula Strike - Upon placing your fingertips on an entity, the entity will begin to float. Right click on an entity to remove their gravity. Crouch and use this power to release all entities you've floated.
